newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-MARKET MAKERS FOR NEW LISTINGS ANNOUNCED.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-MARKET MAKERS FOR NEW LISTINGS ANNOUNCED.

text.p: The Tallinn bourse said on Monday that Hoiupank, Hansapank and Cresco Securities were the market makers for Fakto and Merko shares.
The market makers for Leks Insurance were Hoiupank and Hansapank, it added in a statement.
Shares in Fakto, Estonia's Nissan dealer, and Leks Insurance will be listed on the secondary list of the bourse from Tuesday. Construction company Merko will be listed on the main list.
